summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the tax treatment for the redemption of its class C preferred shares (PNC). The redemption amount is R$52.00 per share, based on the closing price of common shares on June 12, 2026. The record date is June 18, 2026, with payment on July 7, 2026 for Brazilian holders and July 16, 2026 for ADR holders. The company will withhold Brazilian WHT on capital gains for non-resident investors at rates of 15%-25%. This is a capital return event via a cash redemption of preferred shares. What to watch: tax treatment compliance and funding source for the redemption.
